standard · 객체·함수 설명

graphify가 소스 위치를 가진 타입·함수로 추출한 항목을 파일/심볼별로 묶었다. 외부 라이브러리의 정의 없는 타입은 설명 대상으로 꾸며 넣지 않았다. 아래 정의·선언과 실제 구현을 구분하며, 호출 후보는 실행을 보장하지 않는다. 공통 API도 이 대상의 그래프에 포함되어 있다.

위치가 확인되는 타입/함수 항목 607개. 공통 프레임워크 카탈로그

bool validJointRest(const Transform3D& rest) {
    return DiagramSystem::validTransform(rest) && rest.scale.x > 1e-6f &&
           std::abs(rest.scale.x - rest.scale.y) < 1e-6f && std::abs(rest.scale.x - rest.scale.z) < 1e-6f;
}

정의/선언 원문

HumanoidPose HumanoidPose::seated() {
    HumanoidPose pose;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        pose.hips[i].x = -90;
        pose.knees[i].x = 90;
        pose.shoulders[i].x = -20;
        pose.elbows[i].x = -40;
    }

    return pose;
}

정의/선언 원문

std::optional<JointAnimation> AnimationSystem::createJointAnimation(const Scene& scene, EntityId joint,
                                                                    const Motion& motion) {
    const auto* component = scene.getComponent(joint);
    const auto sample = motion.sample(0);

    if (!component || !sample || !detail::validJointRest(component->transform) || !detail::rigidRoom(sample->parent) ||
        !detail::rigidRoom(sample->local)) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationSystem::createJointAnimation",
                            "Need a joint with positive uniform rest scale and a rigid motion sample.");

        return {};
    }

    return JointAnimation{joint, component->transform, motion};
}

정의/선언 원문

bool AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy(Scene& scene, const std::vector<JointAnimation>& animation, double seconds) {
    if (!std::isfinite(seconds) || seconds < 0)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy",
                                   "Need nonnegative finite seconds.");

    std::set<EntityId> seen;
    std::vector<std::pair<EntityId, Transform3D>> staged;

    staged.reserve(animation.size());

    for (const auto& track : animation) {
        const auto sample = track.motion.sample(seconds);
        const auto rest = DiagramSystem::modelMatrix(track.rest);

        if (!scene.getComponent(track.joint) || !seen.insert(track.joint).second || !sample ||
            !detail::validJointRest(track.rest) || !detail::rigidRoom(sample->parent) ||
            !detail::rigidRoom(sample->local))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(
                __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy",
                "Need unique existing joints, positive uniform rest scales and rigid motion samples.");
        // World contributions are in the joint parent's space, before its rest pose.
        const auto matrix = sample->parent * rest * sample->local;
        Transform3D transform;

        transform.basis = glm::vec3(matrix[3]);
        transform.scale = track.rest.scale;
        transform.rotation = glm::mat3(matrix) / track.rest.scale.x;

        if (!DiagramSystem::validTransform(transform))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationSystem::poseHierarchy",
                                       "Joint composition overflow.");
        staged.emplace_back(track.joint, transform);
    }

    for (const auto& item : staged)
        if (!scene.setTransform(item.first, item.second))
            return false;

    return true;
}

정의/선언 원문

std::optional<HumanoidRig> AnimationSystem::addHumanoid(Scene& scene, const HumanoidConfig& config,
                                                        std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    if (!config.grid.valid() || !detail::rigidRoom(config.grid.frame) || !std::isfinite(config.upperArmFraction) ||
        config.upperArmFraction <= 0 || config.upperArmFraction >= 1 || !std::isfinite(config.upperLegFraction) ||
        config.upperLegFraction <= 0 || config.upperLegFraction >= 1 || !detail::validColor(config.torsoColor) ||
        !detail::validColor(config.headColor) || !detail::validColor(config.leftColor) ||
        !detail::validColor(config.rightColor) || (parent && !scene.getComponent(*parent))) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "AnimationSystem::addHumanoid",
                            "Invalid grid, limb fractions, colors or parent.");

        return {};
    }

    Scene staged = scene;
    HumanoidRig rig;
    const auto extent = config.grid.extent;
    Transform3D rootTransform;

    rootTransform.basis = glm::vec3(config.grid.frame[3]);
    rootTransform.rotation = glm::mat3(config.grid.frame);

    const auto root = staged.addGroup(rootTransform);

    if (!root || !staged.setParent(*root, parent))
        return {};
    rig.root = *root;

    const auto pelvis =
        PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.root, config.grid.origin + extent * glm::vec3(.5f, .4f, .5f));

    if (!pelvis)
        return {};
    rig.pelvis = *pelvis;

    const auto torso = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.pelvis, {0, extent.y * .18f, 0});

    if (!torso)
        return {};
    rig.torso = *torso;

    const auto torsoMesh =
        PatternSystem::addBox(staged, extent * glm::vec3(.45f, .35f, .7f), {0, 0, 0}, config.torsoColor, rig.torso);
    const auto neck = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.torso, {0, extent.y * .22f, 0});

    if (!torsoMesh || !neck)
        return {};
    rig.torsoMesh = *torsoMesh;
    rig.neck = *neck;

    const auto head = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, extent * glm::vec3(.3f, .2f, .6f), {0, extent.y * .1f, 0},
                                            config.headColor, rig.neck);
    const auto nose = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, extent * glm::vec3(.1f, .05f, .2f),
                                            {0, extent.y * .1f, extent.z * .4f}, {1, .2f, .2f}, rig.neck);

    if (!head || !nose)
        return {};
    rig.head = *head;
    rig.nose = *nose;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        const float side = i == 0 ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
        const auto color = i == 0 ? config.leftColor : config.rightColor;
        const float upperArm = extent.y * .32f * config.upperArmFraction;
        const float forearm = extent.y * .32f - upperArm;
        const float thigh = extent.y * .4f * config.upperLegFraction;
        const float shin = extent.y * .4f - thigh;
        const auto shoulder = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.torso, {side * extent.x * .3f, extent.y * .14f, 0});
        const auto hip = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.pelvis, {side * extent.x * .15f, 0, 0});

        if (!shoulder || !hip)
            return {};
        rig.shoulders[i] = *shoulder;
        rig.hips[i] = *hip;

        const auto elbow = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *shoulder, {0, -upperArm, 0});
        const auto knee = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *hip, {0, -thigh, 0});

        if (!elbow || !knee)
            return {};
        rig.elbows[i] = *elbow;
        rig.knees[i] = *knee;

        const auto hand = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *elbow, {0, -forearm, 0});
        const auto foot = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *knee, {0, -shin, 0});
        const auto upper = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .15f, upperArm, extent.z * .3f},
                                                 {0, -upperArm / 2, 0}, color, *shoulder);
        const auto lower = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .15f, forearm, extent.z * .3f},
                                                 {0, -forearm / 2, 0}, color, *elbow);
        const auto thighMesh =
            PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .18f, thigh, extent.z * .4f}, {0, -thigh / 2, 0}, color, *hip);
        const auto shinMesh =
            PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .18f, shin, extent.z * .4f}, {0, -shin / 2, 0}, color, *knee);

        if (!hand || !foot || !upper || !lower || !thighMesh || !shinMesh)
            return {};
        rig.hands[i] = *hand;
        rig.feet[i] = *foot;
        rig.upperArms[i] = *upper;
        rig.forearms[i] = *lower;
        rig.thighs[i] = *thighMesh;
        rig.shins[i] = *shinMesh;
    }
    scene = std::move(staged);

    return rig;
}

정의/선언 원문

std::optional<HumanoidRig> AnimationSystem::addHumanoid(Scene& scene, const HumanoidConfig& config,
                                                        std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    if (!config.grid.valid() || !detail::rigidRoom(config.grid.frame) || !std::isfinite(config.upperArmFraction) ||
        config.upperArmFraction <= 0 || config.upperArmFraction >= 1 || !std::isfinite(config.upperLegFraction) ||
        config.upperLegFraction <= 0 || config.upperLegFraction >= 1 || !detail::validColor(config.torsoColor) ||
        !detail::validColor(config.headColor) || !detail::validColor(config.leftColor) ||
        !detail::validColor(config.rightColor) || (parent && !scene.getComponent(*parent))) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "AnimationSystem::addHumanoid",
                            "Invalid grid, limb fractions, colors or parent.");

        return {};
    }

    Scene staged = scene;
    HumanoidRig rig;
    const auto extent = config.grid.extent;
    Transform3D rootTransform;

    rootTransform.basis = glm::vec3(config.grid.frame[3]);
    rootTransform.rotation = glm::mat3(config.grid.frame);

    const auto root = staged.addGroup(rootTransform);

    if (!root || !staged.setParent(*root, parent))
        return {};
    rig.root = *root;

    const auto pelvis =
        PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.root, config.grid.origin + extent * glm::vec3(.5f, .4f, .5f));

    if (!pelvis)
        return {};
    rig.pelvis = *pelvis;

    const auto torso = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.pelvis, {0, extent.y * .18f, 0});

    if (!torso)
        return {};
    rig.torso = *torso;

    const auto torsoMesh =
        PatternSystem::addBox(staged, extent * glm::vec3(.45f, .35f, .7f), {0, 0, 0}, config.torsoColor, rig.torso);
    const auto neck = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.torso, {0, extent.y * .22f, 0});

    if (!torsoMesh || !neck)
        return {};
    rig.torsoMesh = *torsoMesh;
    rig.neck = *neck;

    const auto head = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, extent * glm::vec3(.3f, .2f, .6f), {0, extent.y * .1f, 0},
                                            config.headColor, rig.neck);
    const auto nose = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, extent * glm::vec3(.1f, .05f, .2f),
                                            {0, extent.y * .1f, extent.z * .4f}, {1, .2f, .2f}, rig.neck);

    if (!head || !nose)
        return {};
    rig.head = *head;
    rig.nose = *nose;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        const float side = i == 0 ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
        const auto color = i == 0 ? config.leftColor : config.rightColor;
        const float upperArm = extent.y * .32f * config.upperArmFraction;
        const float forearm = extent.y * .32f - upperArm;
        const float thigh = extent.y * .4f * config.upperLegFraction;
        const float shin = extent.y * .4f - thigh;
        const auto shoulder = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.torso, {side * extent.x * .3f, extent.y * .14f, 0});
        const auto hip = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.pelvis, {side * extent.x * .15f, 0, 0});

        if (!shoulder || !hip)
            return {};
        rig.shoulders[i] = *shoulder;
        rig.hips[i] = *hip;

        const auto elbow = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *shoulder, {0, -upperArm, 0});
        const auto knee = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *hip, {0, -thigh, 0});

        if (!elbow || !knee)
            return {};
        rig.elbows[i] = *elbow;
        rig.knees[i] = *knee;

        const auto hand = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *elbow, {0, -forearm, 0});
        const auto foot = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, *knee, {0, -shin, 0});
        const auto upper = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .15f, upperArm, extent.z * .3f},
                                                 {0, -upperArm / 2, 0}, color, *shoulder);
        const auto lower = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .15f, forearm, extent.z * .3f},
                                                 {0, -forearm / 2, 0}, color, *elbow);
        const auto thighMesh =
            PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .18f, thigh, extent.z * .4f}, {0, -thigh / 2, 0}, color, *hip);
        const auto shinMesh =
            PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {extent.x * .18f, shin, extent.z * .4f}, {0, -shin / 2, 0}, color, *knee);

        if (!hand || !foot || !upper || !lower || !thighMesh || !shinMesh)
            return {};
        rig.hands[i] = *hand;
        rig.feet[i] = *foot;
        rig.upperArms[i] = *upper;
        rig.forearms[i] = *lower;
        rig.thighs[i] = *thighMesh;
        rig.shins[i] = *shinMesh;
    }
    scene = std::move(staged);

    return rig;
}

정의/선언 원문

bool AnimationSystem::poseHumanoid(Scene& scene, const HumanoidRig& rig, const HumanoidPose& pose) {
    const std::array<EntityId, 11> joints{rig.pelvis,       rig.torso,     rig.neck,      rig.shoulders[0],
                                          rig.shoulders[1], rig.elbows[0], rig.elbows[1], rig.hips[0],
                                          rig.hips[1],      rig.knees[0],  rig.knees[1]};
    const std::array<glm::vec3, 11> angles{pose.pelvisDegrees, pose.torsoDegrees, pose.neckDegrees, pose.shoulders[0],
                                           pose.shoulders[1],  pose.elbows[0],    pose.elbows[1],   pose.hips[0],
                                           pose.hips[1],       pose.knees[0],     pose.knees[1]};
    std::set<EntityId> seen;
    std::array<Transform3D, 11> transforms;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i) {
        const auto* component = scene.getComponent(joints[i]);

        if (!component || !seen.insert(joints[i]).second || !detail::finiteVector(angles[i]))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationSystem::poseHumanoid",
                                       "Invalid joint or Euler angles.");

        glm::mat4 rotation(1);

        for (int axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis) {
            glm::vec3 direction(0);

            direction[axis] = 1;

            const auto turn = TransformSystem::rotation({{0, 0, 0}, direction}, angles[i][axis]);

            if (!turn)
                return false;
            rotation = *turn * rotation;
        }
        transforms[i] = component->transform;
        transforms[i].rotation = glm::mat3(rotation);

        if (!DiagramSystem::validTransform(transforms[i]))
            return false;
    }

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i)
        if (!scene.setTransform(joints[i], transforms[i]))
            return false;

    return true;
}

                                          rig.shoulders[1], rig.elbows[0], rig.elbows[1], rig.hips[0],
                                          rig.hips[1],      rig.knees[0],  rig.knees[1]};
    const std::array<glm::vec3, 11> angles{pose.pelvisDegrees, pose.torsoDegrees, pose.neckDegrees, pose.shoulders[0],
                                           pose.shoulders[1],  pose.elbows[0],    pose.elbows[1],   pose.hips[0],
                                           pose.hips[1],       pose.knees[0],     pose.knees[1]};
    std::set<EntityId> seen;
    std::array<Transform3D, 11> transforms;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i) {
        const auto* component = scene.getComponent(joints[i]);

        if (!component || !seen.insert(joints[i]).second || !detail::finiteVector(angles[i]))
            return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "AnimationSystem::poseHumanoid",
                                       "Invalid joint or Euler angles.");

        glm::mat4 rotation(1);

        for (int axis = 0; axis < 3; ++axis) {
            glm::vec3 direction(0);

            direction[axis] = 1;

            const auto turn = TransformSystem::rotation({{0, 0, 0}, direction}, angles[i][axis]);

            if (!turn)
                return false;
            rotation = *turn * rotation;

        transforms[i] = component->transform;
        transforms[i].rotation = glm::mat3(rotation);

        if (!DiagramSystem::validTransform(transforms[i]))

    }

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < joints.size(); ++i)

            return false;

    return true;

정의/선언 원문

std::optional<SwingRig> AnimationSystem::addSwingWithRider(Scene& scene, const SwingConfig& config,
                                                           std::optional<EntityId> parent) {
    Motion swingMotion;
    auto pendulum = config.pendulum;

    pendulum.axis.point = {0, 0, 0};
    pendulum.space = TransformSpace::Local;

    if (!detail::finiteVector(config.pivot) || !detail::positiveLengths(config.seatSize) ||
        !std::isfinite(config.length) || config.length <= 0 || !std::isfinite(config.ropeThickness) ||
        config.ropeThickness <= 0 || !std::isfinite(config.riderSwayDegrees) || config.riderSwayDegrees < 0 ||
        (parent && !scene.getComponent(*parent)) || !swingMotion.append(Motion::pendulum(pendulum))) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "AnimationSystem::addSwingWithRider",
                            "Invalid swing configuration or parent.");

        return {};
    }

    Scene staged = scene;
    SwingRig rig;
    Transform3D transform;

    transform.basis = config.pivot;

    const auto frame = staged.addGroup(transform);

    if (!frame || !staged.setParent(*frame, parent))
        return {};
    rig.frame = *frame;

    const auto hinge = PatternSystem::addJoint(staged, rig.frame, {0, 0, 0});

    if (!hinge)
        return {};
    rig.hinge = *hinge;

    const auto seat =
        PatternSystem::addBox(staged, config.seatSize, {0, -config.length, 0}, {.55f, .3f, .1f}, rig.hinge);

    if (!seat)
        return {};
    rig.seat = *seat;

    if (!PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {config.seatSize.x + .6f, .12f, .12f}, {0, 0, 0}, {.3f, .35f, .4f}, rig.frame))
        return {};

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        const float side = i == 0 ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
        const auto rope = PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {config.ropeThickness, config.length, config.ropeThickness},
                                                {side * config.seatSize.x * .43f, -config.length / 2, 0},
                                                {.75f, .75f, .75f}, rig.hinge);

        if (!rope || !PatternSystem::addBox(staged, {.12f, config.length + 1, .12f},
                                            {side * (config.seatSize.x / 2 + .2f), -(config.length + 1) / 2, 0},
                                            {.3f, .35f, .4f}, rig.frame))
            return {};
        rig.ropes[i] = *rope;
    }

    const auto person = addHumanoid(staged, config.person, rig.seat);

    if (!person || !poseHumanoid(staged, *person, HumanoidPose::seated()))
        return {};
    rig.person = *person;

    const auto* root = staged.getComponent(rig.person.root);
    auto personTransform = root->transform;
    const auto hipCenter = config.person.grid.origin + config.person.grid.extent * glm::vec3(.5f, .4f, .5f);
    const float thighHalfThickness = config.person.grid.extent.z * .2f;

    personTransform.basis =
        glm::vec3(0, config.seatSize.y / 2 + thighHalfThickness, 0) - personTransform.rotation * hipCenter;

    if (!staged.setTransform(rig.person.root, personTransform))
        return {};

    const auto swingTrack = createJointAnimation(staged, rig.hinge, swingMotion);
    PendulumMotion rider;

    rider.periodSeconds = pendulum.periodSeconds;
    rider.amplitudeDegrees = config.riderSwayDegrees;
    rider.phaseDegrees = std::remainder(pendulum.phaseDegrees, 360.0) + 180;

    Motion riderMotion;

    if (!riderMotion.append(Motion::pendulum(rider)))
        return {};

    const auto riderTrack = createJointAnimation(staged, rig.person.torso, riderMotion);

    if (!swingTrack || !riderTrack)
        return {};
    rig.animation = {*swingTrack, *riderTrack};

    if (!poseHierarchy(staged, rig.animation, 0))
        return {};
    scene = std::move(staged);

    return rig;
}

bool Application::configureRenderer(const RenderConfig& config, const std::filesystem::path& vertexPath,
                                    const std::filesystem::path& fragmentPath) {

        return true;
    requestClose();
    return false;
}

bool Application::ensureContext(const char* operation, const char* file, int line) {
    Diagnostics::locate(file, line, operation);

    if (contextFailed_)
        return false;

    if (!window_ || GetCurrentThreadId() != contextThread_) {
        contextFailed_ = true;

        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Application::ensureContext",
            "창이 없거나 컨텍스트를 생성한 스레드와 다른 스레드에서 사용했습니다.",
            "창 생성·렌더링·종료를 같은 스레드에서 수행하세요. Application::run과 사용자 렌더 콜백을 확인하세요.");
    }
    using CurrentProc = void*(WINAPI*)();

    const auto module = GetModuleHandleW(L"opengl32.dll");
    const auto current =
        module ? reinterpret_cast<CurrentProc>(::GetProcAddress(module, "wglGetCurrentContext")) : nullptr;

    if (nativeContext_ && detail::glfw().GetCurrentContext() == window_ && current && current() == nativeContext_)
        return true;

    const auto serial = detail::contextErrorSerial();

    detail::glfw().MakeContextCurrent(window_);

    if (serial != detail::contextErrorSerial() || detail::glfw().GetCurrentContext() != window_ || !current ||
        !current()) {
        contextFailed_ = true;

        return Diagnostics::fail(
            PipelineStage::Runtime, "glfwMakeContextCurrent",
            "WGL이 요청한 컨텍스트를 연결하지 못하여 GL 명령 전에 렌더링을 중단했습니다.",
            "소스 위치는 연결 실패 호출입니다. 창 수명·렌더 스레드·컨텍스트를 해제/파괴하는 외부 콜백을 먼저 확인하세요. 이상이 없으면 GPU 드라이버·세션을 확인하세요. 이 로그만으로 드라이버 원인을 확정할 수 없습니다.");
    }
    nativeContext_ = current();

    return true;
}

정의/선언 원문

bool Application::initialize(const ApplicationConfig& config) {
    contextThread_ = GetCurrentThreadId();
    contextFailed_ = false;
    nativeContext_ = nullptr;
    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::Runtime, "Application::initialize");

    const auto root = detail::relativePathInside(detail::executableDirectory(), config.projectRoot);
    const auto runtime = detail::relativePathInside(root, config.runtimeDirectory);

    detail::glfw().load(runtime);
    detail::glfw().SetErrorCallback([](int code, const char* message) {
        ++detail::contextErrorSerial();
        Diagnostics::fail(
            PipelineStage::Runtime, "GLFW/WGL", std::to_string(code) + ": " + (message ? message : "알 수 없는 오류"),
            "표시된 소스 위치·호출 경로에서 컨텍스트 연결이 실패했습니다. Application의 창 수명과 스레드를 먼저 확인하세요. OS/드라이버 원문도 함께 보세요. 렌더 패스마다 별도 WGL 컨텍스트를 만들 필요는 없습니다.");
    });

    if (config.width <= 0 || config.height <= 0)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Application::initialize",
                                   "창 너비와 높이는 양수여야 합니다.");

    if (!detail::glfw().Init())
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "glfwInit",
                                   "GLFW 초기화 실패: 앞선 GLFW 오류를 확인하세요.");
    glfwInitialized_ = true;
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MAJOR, 3);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MINOR, 3);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_OPENGL_PROFILE, GLFW_OPENGL_CORE_PROFILE);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_DOUBLEBUFFER, GLFW_TRUE);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_DEPTH_BITS, 24);
    window_ = detail::glfw().createWindow(config.width, config.height, config.title.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr);

    if (window_ == nullptr) {
        return Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "glfwCreateWindow",
                                   "OpenGL 3.3 코어 창 생성 실패.",
                                   "앞선 GLFW 오류와 그래픽 드라이버의 OpenGL 지원을 확인하세요.");
    }

    if (!ensureContext("initialize -> attach new window", __FILE__, __LINE__))
        return false;
    detail::glfw().SwapInterval(config.verticalSync ? 1 : 0);

    const auto vertexPath = config.shaderDirectory.empty()
                                ? std::filesystem::path{}
                                : detail::relativePathInside(root, config.shaderDirectory) / "VertexShader.glsl";
    const auto fragmentPath = config.shaderDirectory.empty()
                                  ? std::filesystem::path{}
                                  : detail::relativePathInside(root, config.shaderDirectory) / "FragmentShader.glsl";

    Diagnostics::locate(__FILE__, __LINE__, "initialize -> Renderer::initialize -> shader source/path setup");

    if (!renderer_.initialize(vertexPath, fragmentPath, config.renderConfig))
        return false;
    assets_.emplace(root, config.features);
    renderOptions_.textures = config.features.textures;

    detail::glfw().SetInputMode(window_, GLFW_LOCK_KEY_MODS, GLFW_TRUE);
    detail::glfw().SetWindowUserPointer(window_, this);
    detail::glfw().SetKeyCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window, int key, int, int action, int mods) {
        auto& app = *static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));

        app.dispatch([&] {
            if (app.modifiedKeyHandler_)
                app.modifiedKeyHandler_(app, key, action, mods);
            else if (app.keyHandler_)
                app.keyHandler_(app, key, action);
        });
    });
    detail::glfw().SetWindowFocusCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window, int focused) {
        auto& app = *static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));

        app.dispatch([&] {
            if (app.focusHandler_)
                app.focusHandler_(app, focused == GLFW_TRUE);
        });
    });
    detail::glfw().SetMouseButtonCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window, int button, int action, int mods) {
        auto& app = *static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));

        app.dispatch([&] {
            if (!app.mouseHandler_)
                return;

            MouseEvent event;

            event.button = button;
            event.action = action;
            event.mods = mods;
            detail::glfw().GetCursorPos(window, &event.windowX, &event.windowY);

            int ww = 0, wh = 0, fw = 0, fh = 0;

            detail::glfw().GetWindowSize(window, &ww, &wh);
            detail::glfw().GetFramebufferSize(window, &fw, &fh);

            if (ww <= 0 || wh <= 0 || fw <= 0 || fh <= 0)
                return;
            event.framebufferX = event.windowX * fw / ww;
            event.framebufferY = event.windowY * fh / wh;
            app.mouseHandler_(app, event);
        });
    });
    detail::glfw().SetCursorPosCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window, double x, double y) {
        auto& app = *static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));

        app.dispatch([&] {
            if (app.cursorHandler_)
                app.cursorHandler_(app, x, y);
        });
    });

    return true;
}

void Application::shutdown() {
    assets_.reset();

    if (window_ != nullptr) {
        if (!contextFailed_ && ensureContext("shutdown -> GPU cleanup", __FILE__, __LINE__))
            renderer_.destroy();
        else
            renderer_.abandon();
        detail::glfw().SetWindowUserPointer(window_, nullptr);
        detail::glfw().DestroyWindow(window_);
        window_ = nullptr;
    }

    if (glfwInitialized_) {
        detail::glfw().Terminate();
        glfwInitialized_ = false;
    }
}

그래프의 직접 호출 후보이 앵커의 직접 호출 간선이 없음. 아래 본문과 pipeline의 콜백 흐름을 확인한다.

정의/선언 원문

int Application::run(const ApplicationConfig& config) {
    Diagnostics::configure(config.diagnostics);
    Diagnostics::clear();

    if (running_) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Application::run",
                            "run() 재귀 호출은 허용하지 않습니다.");

        return -1; // 콜백에서 run()을 재귀 호출하지 않는다.
    }

    if (detail::applicationActive()) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Application::run",
                            "동시에 실행 중인 Application은 하나만 지원합니다.");

        return -1;
    }
    // /utf-8 encodes narrow strings; the Windows console must decode them as UTF-8.
    SetConsoleOutputCP(CP_UTF8);
    detail::applicationActive() = true;
    callbackError_ = nullptr;
    running_ = true;

    int exitCode = 0;

    try {
        if (!initialize(config)) {
            std::cerr << "애플리케이션 초기화 실패.\n";
            exitCode = -1;
        } else if (initHandler_ && !initHandler_(*this)) {
            Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Application::initHandler",
                                "사용자 초기화 콜백이 false를 반환했습니다.",
                                "앞선 API 오류와 장면 생성 콜백을 확인하세요.");
            std::cerr << "사용자 장면 초기화 실패.\n";
            exitCode = -1;
        } else {
            double previousTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();

            while (!detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                Diagnostics::locate(__FILE__, __LINE__, "run -> glfwPollEvents/input callbacks");
                detail::glfw().PollEvents();

                if (callbackError_)
                    std::rethrow_exception(callbackError_);

                if (detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                    break;
                }

                int width = 0;
                int height = 0;

                detail::glfw().GetFramebufferSize(window_, &width, &height);

                if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
                    detail::glfw().WaitEvents();

                    if (callbackError_)
                        std::rethrow_exception(callbackError_);
                    previousTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();
                    continue;
                }

                const double currentTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();
                const float deltaTime = static_cast<float>(std::clamp(currentTime - previousTime, 0.0, 0.05));

                previousTime = currentTime;

                if (updateHandler_) {
                    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::Input, "Application::updateHandler");
                    updateHandler_(*this, deltaTime);
                }

                if (detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                    break;
                }

                if (!scene_.updateMotions(deltaTime)) {
                    std::cerr << "모션 갱신 실패.\n";
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }

                if (!ensureContext("run -> render callback", __FILE__, __LINE__)) {
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }

                const bool rendered = renderHandler_ ? renderHandler_(*this) : renderScene();

                if (!rendered) {
                    std::cerr << "렌더링 실패.\n";
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }
                Diagnostics::locate(__FILE__, __LINE__, "run -> glfwSwapBuffers");

                const auto swapSerial = detail::contextErrorSerial();

                detail::glfw().SwapBuffers(window_);

                if (swapSerial != detail::contextErrorSerial()) {
                    contextFailed_ = true;
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Application::run", error.what(),
            "앞선 파이프라인 단계/API 오류를 확인하세요. 사용자 콜백 예외는 자원 정리 후 다시 전달됩니다.");
        shutdown();
        running_ = false;
        detail::applicationActive() = false;
        throw;
    } catch (...) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Application::run",
                            "콜백 또는 실행 처리에서 표준 예외가 아닌 예외가 발생했습니다.");
        shutdown();
        running_ = false;
        detail::applicationActive() = false;
        throw; // 사용자 예외를 숨기지 않고 컨텍스트 자원부터 정리한다.
    }
    shutdown();
    running_ = false;
    detail::applicationActive() = false;

    return exitCode;
}

정의/선언 원문

int Application::run(const ApplicationConfig& config) {
    Diagnostics::configure(config.diagnostics);
    Diagnostics::clear();

    if (running_) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Application::run",
                            "run() 재귀 호출은 허용하지 않습니다.");

        return -1; // 콜백에서 run()을 재귀 호출하지 않는다.
    }

    if (detail::applicationActive()) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Application::run",
                            "동시에 실행 중인 Application은 하나만 지원합니다.");

        return -1;
    }
    // /utf-8 encodes narrow strings; the Windows console must decode them as UTF-8.
    SetConsoleOutputCP(CP_UTF8);
    detail::applicationActive() = true;
    callbackError_ = nullptr;
    running_ = true;

    int exitCode = 0;

    try {
        if (!initialize(config)) {
            std::cerr << "애플리케이션 초기화 실패.\n";
            exitCode = -1;
        } else if (initHandler_ && !initHandler_(*this)) {
            Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Scene, "Application::initHandler",
                                "사용자 초기화 콜백이 false를 반환했습니다.",
                                "앞선 API 오류와 장면 생성 콜백을 확인하세요.");
            std::cerr << "사용자 장면 초기화 실패.\n";
            exitCode = -1;
        } else {
            double previousTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();

            while (!detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                Diagnostics::locate(__FILE__, __LINE__, "run -> glfwPollEvents/input callbacks");
                detail::glfw().PollEvents();

                if (callbackError_)
                    std::rethrow_exception(callbackError_);

                if (detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                    break;
                }

                int width = 0;
                int height = 0;

                detail::glfw().GetFramebufferSize(window_, &width, &height);

                if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
                    detail::glfw().WaitEvents();

                    if (callbackError_)
                        std::rethrow_exception(callbackError_);
                    previousTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();
                    continue;
                }

                const double currentTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();
                const float deltaTime = static_cast<float>(std::clamp(currentTime - previousTime, 0.0, 0.05));

                previousTime = currentTime;

                if (updateHandler_) {
                    Diagnostics::trace(PipelineStage::Input, "Application::updateHandler");
                    updateHandler_(*this, deltaTime);
                }

                if (detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                    break;
                }

                if (!scene_.updateMotions(deltaTime)) {
                    std::cerr << "모션 갱신 실패.\n";
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }

                if (!ensureContext("run -> render callback", __FILE__, __LINE__)) {
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }

                const bool rendered = renderHandler_ ? renderHandler_(*this) : renderScene();

                if (!rendered) {
                    std::cerr << "렌더링 실패.\n";
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }
                Diagnostics::locate(__FILE__, __LINE__, "run -> glfwSwapBuffers");

                const auto swapSerial = detail::contextErrorSerial();

                detail::glfw().SwapBuffers(window_);

                if (swapSerial != detail::contextErrorSerial()) {
                    contextFailed_ = true;
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Application::run", error.what(),
            "앞선 파이프라인 단계/API 오류를 확인하세요. 사용자 콜백 예외는 자원 정리 후 다시 전달됩니다.");
        shutdown();
        running_ = false;
        detail::applicationActive() = false;
        throw;
    } catch (...) {
        Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Application::run",
                            "콜백 또는 실행 처리에서 표준 예외가 아닌 예외가 발생했습니다.");
        shutdown();
        running_ = false;
        detail::applicationActive() = false;
        throw; // 사용자 예외를 숨기지 않고 컨텍스트 자원부터 정리한다.
    }
    shutdown();
    running_ = false;
    detail::applicationActive() = false;

    return exitCode;
}

std::optional<PickResult> Application::pickAt(double x, double y) const {
    if (!window_)
        return {};

    int ww = 0, wh = 0, fw = 0, fh = 0;

    detail::glfw().GetWindowSize(window_, &ww, &wh);
    detail::glfw().GetFramebufferSize(window_, &fw, &fh);

    if (ww <= 0 || wh <= 0 || fw <= 0 || fh <= 0)
        return {};

    return graphics::pick(scene_, camera_, x * fw / ww, y * fh / wh, {0, 0, double(fw), double(fh)});
}

정의/선언 원문

bool validFaceRotation(const std::optional<FaceRotationConfig>& rotation) {
    if (!rotation) return true;
    if (!std::isfinite(rotation->degrees)) return false;
    if (rotation->kind == FaceRotationKind::EdgeHinge) return rotation->edge < 4;
    return (rotation->kind == FaceRotationKind::SelfSpin || rotation->kind == FaceRotationKind::ModelOrbit) &&
           detail::finiteVector(rotation->axis) && glm::length(glm::dvec3(rotation->axis)) > 1e-12;
}

정의/선언 원문

bool validCuboid(const CuboidConfig& c) {
    if (c.name.empty() || !detail::finiteVector(c.size) || c.size.x <= 0 || c.size.y <= 0 || c.size.z <= 0 ||
        !detail::validColor(c.color) || !DiagramSystem::validTransform(c.transform))
        return false;
    for (const auto& face : c.faces)
        if (!DiagramSystem::validTransform(face.transform) || !detail::validColor(face.color) || !validFaceRotation(face.rotation) ||
            (face.mode != FaceTransformMode::Hierarchy && face.mode != FaceTransformMode::Independent) ||
            (face.cull != CullMode::Inherit && face.cull != CullMode::None &&
             face.cull != CullMode::Back && face.cull != CullMode::Front))
            return false;
    return !c.motion || bool(c.motion->sample(0));
}

template<class Id> std::optional<Id> lookup(const std::map<std::string, Id>& map, const std::string& name) {
    const auto found = map.find(name);
    return found == map.end() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Id>(found->second);
}

정의/선언 원문

bool CuboidMode::setConfig(const CuboidModeConfig& config) {
    const auto& options = config.renderOptions;
    if (!CameraSystem::validCamera(config.camera) || !detail::finiteVector(options.lightDirection) ||
        glm::length(options.lightDirection) < 1e-12f || !detail::validColor(options.lightColor) ||
        !detail::validColor(options.outlineColor) || !std::isfinite(options.background.x) ||
        !std::isfinite(options.background.y) || !std::isfinite(options.background.z) ||
        !std::isfinite(options.background.w) || (options.cull != CullMode::None &&
        options.cull != CullMode::Back && options.cull != CullMode::Front))
        return false;
    std::vector<std::string> names;
    for (const auto& cuboid : config.cuboids) {
        if (!validCuboid(cuboid) || std::find(names.begin(), names.end(), cuboid.name) != names.end())
            return false;
        names.push_back(cuboid.name);
    }
    config_ = config;
    return true;
}

정의/선언 원문

bool CuboidMode::setCuboid(const CuboidConfig& cuboid) {
    auto next = config_;
    const auto found = std::find_if(next.cuboids.begin(), next.cuboids.end(),
                                    [&](const auto& c) { return c.name == cuboid.name; });
    if (found == next.cuboids.end()) next.cuboids.push_back(cuboid);
    else *found = cuboid;
    return setConfig(next);
}

정의/선언 원문

bool CuboidMode::bindKey(const CuboidKeyBinding& binding) {
    if (!binding.handler || (binding.action != GLFW_PRESS && binding.action != GLFW_RELEASE && binding.action != GLFW_REPEAT))
        return false;
    const auto found = std::find_if(bindings_.begin(), bindings_.end(), [&](const auto& b) {
        return b.key == binding.key && b.action == binding.action && b.mods == binding.mods;
    });
    if (found == bindings_.end()) bindings_.push_back(binding);
    else *found = binding;
    return true;
}

bool CuboidMode::unbindKey(int key, int action, int mods) {
    const auto found = std::find_if(bindings_.begin(), bindings_.end(), [&](const auto& b) {
        return b.key == key && b.action == action && b.mods == mods;
    });
    if (found == bindings_.end()) return false;
    bindings_.erase(found);
    return true;
}

정의/선언 원문

bool CuboidMode::apply(Application& app) {
    Scene staged;
    std::map<std::string, EntityId> entities;
    std::map<std::string, LayerId> layers;
    std::map<std::string, MotionId> motions;
    for (const auto& c : config_.cuboids) {
        if (!validCuboid(c)) return false;
        auto model = DiagramSystem::makePolyhedron(GLShape::Cube, c.size);
        for (std::size_t face = 0; face < c.faces.size(); ++face)
            model.faces[face].color = c.faces[face].color;
        const auto id = staged.addModel(model, c.transform, PivotMode::Preserve);
        if (!id || !staged.setTransform(*id, c.transform) || !staged.setTint(*id, c.color) ||
            !staged.setVisible(*id, c.visible)) return false;
        for (std::size_t face = 0; face < c.faces.size(); ++face)
            if (!staged.setFaceTransform(*id, face, c.faces[face].transform, true) ||
                !staged.setFaceVisible(*id, face, c.faces[face].visible) ||
                !staged.setFaceCullMode(*id, face, c.faces[face].cull) ||
                (c.faces[face].rotation && !PatternSystem::rotateFace(staged, *id, face, *c.faces[face].rotation))) return false;
        entities.emplace(c.name, *id);
        if (c.motion) {
            const auto motion = staged.getMotions().createMotion(*c.motion);
            if (!motion) return false;
            LayerConfig layer;
            layer.motion = *motion;
            const auto idLayer = staged.getMotions().pushLayer(MotionSystem::rootLayer(), layer);
            if (!idLayer || !staged.bindEntity(*id, *idLayer)) return false;
            layers.emplace(c.name, *idLayer);
            motions.emplace(c.name, *motion);
        }
        // Freeze independent faces only after the initial motion/layer binding exists.
        for (std::size_t face = 0; face < c.faces.size(); ++face)
            if (!staged.setFaceTransformMode(*id, face, c.faces[face].mode)) return false;
    }
    app.getScene() = std::move(staged);
    app.getCamera() = config_.camera;
    app.getRenderOptions() = config_.renderOptions;
    entities_ = std::move(entities);
    layers_ = std::move(layers);
    motions_ = std::move(motions);
    const auto setup = setup_;
    return !setup || setup(app, *this);
}

bool CuboidMode::dispatch(Application& app, int key, int action, int mods) {
    for (const auto& binding : bindings_)
        if (binding.key == key && binding.action == action && binding.mods == mods) {
            const auto handler = binding.handler;
            return handler(app, *this);
        }
    return true; // Unbound keys are normal.
}

그래프의 직접 호출 후보이 앵커의 직접 호출 간선이 없음. 아래 본문과 pipeline의 콜백 흐름을 확인한다.

정의/선언 원문

CuboidHandler CuboidMode::action(std::string name, CuboidCommand command) {
    return [name = std::move(name), command](Application& app, CuboidMode& mode) {
        const auto id = mode.entity(name);
        auto& scene = app.getScene();
        if (!id) return false;
        const auto* component = scene.getComponent(*id);
        if (!component) return false;
        auto value = component->transform;
        MotionAction action;
        switch (command.operation) {
        case CuboidOperation::Position: action = SceneActions::position(scene, *id, command.value); break;
        case CuboidOperation::Translate:
            action = SceneActions::position(scene, *id, value.basis + command.value); break;
        case CuboidOperation::Rotate: {
            const auto rotation = TransformSystem::rotation({glm::vec3(0), command.value}, command.degrees);
            if (!rotation) return false;
            value.rotation = value.rotation * glm::mat3(*rotation);
            action = SceneActions::transform(scene, *id, value); break;
        }
        case CuboidOperation::Scale: action = SceneActions::scale(scene, *id, command.value); break;
        case CuboidOperation::Transform: action = SceneActions::transform(scene, *id, command.transform); break;
        case CuboidOperation::Pivot: action = SceneActions::pivot(scene, *id, command.value); break;
        case CuboidOperation::Visible: action = SceneActions::visible(scene, *id, command.enabled); break;
        case CuboidOperation::ToggleVisible: action = SceneActions::visible(scene, *id, !component->visible); break;
        case CuboidOperation::Layer: action = SceneActions::layer(scene, *id, command.layer); break;
        case CuboidOperation::Motion: {
            const auto layer = scene.getEntityLayer(*id);
            return layer && scene.getMotions().bindMotion(*layer, command.motion);
        }
        case CuboidOperation::Playing: {
            const auto layer = scene.getEntityLayer(*id);
            const auto* state = layer ? scene.getMotions().getLayer(*layer) : nullptr;
            return state && state->config.motion && scene.getMotions().setMotionPlaying(*state->config.motion, command.enabled);
        }
        default: return false;
        }
        return action(0, MotionSample{});
    };
}

정의/선언 원문

bool bindCuboidMode(Application& app, std::shared_ptr<CuboidMode> mode) {
    if (!mode) return false;
    app.setInitHandler([mode](Application& app) { return mode->apply(app); });
    app.setUpdateHandler([mode](Application& app, float dt) {
        if (!mode->update(app, dt)) app.requestClose();
    });
    app.setModifiedKeyHandler([mode](Application& app, int key, int action, int mods) {
        if (!mode->dispatch(app, key, action, mods)) app.requestClose();
    });
    return true;
}

bool Motion::validStep(const MotionStep& step) {
    return (bool(step.transform) != bool(step.action)) && std::isfinite(step.startSeconds) && step.startSeconds >= 0 &&
           (!step.durationSeconds || (std::isfinite(*step.durationSeconds) && *step.durationSeconds >= 0 &&
                                      std::isfinite(step.startSeconds + *step.durationSeconds)));
}

    if (index > steps_.size() || !validStep(step))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(

    return true;
}

정의/선언 원문

bool Motion::then(MotionStep step) {
    double end = 0;

    for (const auto& current : steps_) {
        if (!current.durationSeconds)
            return Diagnostics::failAt(
                __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "Motion::then",
                "Rejected condition: !current.durationSeconds",
                "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.");
        end = std::max(end, current.startSeconds + *current.durationSeconds);
    }
    step.startSeconds += end;

    return append(step);
}

}

정의/선언 원문

std::optional<MotionSample> Motion::evaluate(double seconds, bool actions) const {
    if (!std::isfinite(seconds) || seconds < 0)
        return (
            Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "Motion::sample",
                                "Rejected condition: !std::isfinite(seconds) || seconds < 0",
                                "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."),
            std::nullopt);

    MotionSample result;

    for (const auto& step : steps_) {
        if (!step.enabled || seconds < step.startSeconds)
            continue;

        double time = seconds - step.startSeconds;

        if (step.durationSeconds)
            time = std::min(time, *step.durationSeconds);

        if (step.action) {
            if (actions && !step.action(time, result))
                return (Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "Motion::execute",
                                            "Action returned false; prior external effects are retained."), std::nullopt);
            continue;
        }
        const auto matrix = step.transform(time);

        if (!TransformSystem::validAffine(matrix))
            return (Diagnostics::failAt(
                        __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "Motion::sample",
                        "Rejected condition: !TransformSystem::validAffine(matrix)",
                        "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."),
                    std::nullopt);

        auto& target = step.space == TransformSpace::World ? result.parent : result.local;

        target = matrix * target; // Within each space, API order is application order.

        if (!TransformSystem::validAffine(target))
            return (Diagnostics::failAt(
                        __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "Motion::sample",
                        "Rejected condition: !TransformSystem::validAffine(target)",
                        "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."),
                    std::nullopt);
    }

    return result;
}

정의/선언 원문

MotionStep Motion::rotation(const RotationMotion& config) {
    MotionStep step;

    if (!std::isfinite(config.degreesPerSecond) || !std::isfinite(config.initialDegrees) ||
        !TransformSystem::rotation(config.axis, config.initialDegrees))
        return step;
    step.space = config.space;
    step.transform = [config](double seconds) {
        const auto matrix =
            TransformSystem::rotation(config.axis, config.initialDegrees + config.degreesPerSecond * seconds);

        if (!matrix)
            throw std::domain_error("Rotation motion produced an invalid matrix.");

        return *matrix;
    };

    return step;
}

정의/선언 원문

MotionStep Motion::followPath(const PathMotion& config) {
    MotionStep step;

    if (!config.path || !config.interpolation || !std::isfinite(config.durationSeconds) ||
        config.durationSeconds <= 0 || !std::isfinite(config.rate) || config.rate == 0 ||
        !std::isfinite(config.phase) || config.phase < 0 || config.phase > 1)
        return step;
    step.space = config.space;

    if (config.playback == Playback::Once) {
        step.durationSeconds =
            (config.rate > 0 ? 1 - config.phase : config.phase) * config.durationSeconds / std::abs(config.rate);

        if (!std::isfinite(*step.durationSeconds))
            return MotionStep{};
    }
    step.transform = [config](double seconds) {
        double progress = config.phase + seconds / config.durationSeconds * config.rate;

        if (!std::isfinite(progress))
            throw std::domain_error("Path time overflow.");

        if (config.playback == Playback::Once)
            progress = std::clamp(progress, 0.0, 1.0);
        else if (config.playback == Playback::Loop)
            progress -= std::floor(progress);
        else {
            progress -= std::floor(progress / 2) * 2;

            if (progress > 1)
                progress = 2 - progress;
        }

        const double u = config.interpolation(progress);

        if (!std::isfinite(u))
            throw std::domain_error("Interpolation returned non-finite progress.");

        glm::vec3 offset = config.path(u);

        if (config.relativeToStart) {
            const double initial = config.interpolation(config.phase);

            if (!std::isfinite(initial))
                throw std::domain_error("Invalid initial interpolation.");
            offset -= config.path(initial);
        }

        const auto matrix = TransformSystem::translation(offset);

        if (!matrix)
            throw std::domain_error("Path returned a non-finite position.");

        return *matrix;
    };

    return step;
}

정의/선언 원문

MotionStep Motion::followPath(const PathMotion& config) {
    MotionStep step;

    if (!config.path || !config.interpolation || !std::isfinite(config.durationSeconds) ||
        config.durationSeconds <= 0 || !std::isfinite(config.rate) || config.rate == 0 ||
        !std::isfinite(config.phase) || config.phase < 0 || config.phase > 1)
        return step;
    step.space = config.space;

    if (config.playback == Playback::Once) {
        step.durationSeconds =
            (config.rate > 0 ? 1 - config.phase : config.phase) * config.durationSeconds / std::abs(config.rate);

        if (!std::isfinite(*step.durationSeconds))
            return MotionStep{};
    }
    step.transform = [config](double seconds) {
        double progress = config.phase + seconds / config.durationSeconds * config.rate;

        if (!std::isfinite(progress))
            throw std::domain_error("Path time overflow.");

        if (config.playback == Playback::Once)
            progress = std::clamp(progress, 0.0, 1.0);
        else if (config.playback == Playback::Loop)
            progress -= std::floor(progress);
        else {
            progress -= std::floor(progress / 2) * 2;

            if (progress > 1)
                progress = 2 - progress;
        }

        const double u = config.interpolation(progress);

        if (!std::isfinite(u))
            throw std::domain_error("Interpolation returned non-finite progress.");

        glm::vec3 offset = config.path(u);

        if (config.relativeToStart) {
            const double initial = config.interpolation(config.phase);

            if (!std::isfinite(initial))
                throw std::domain_error("Invalid initial interpolation.");
            offset -= config.path(initial);
        }

        const auto matrix = TransformSystem::translation(offset);

        if (!matrix)
            throw std::domain_error("Path returned a non-finite position.");

        return *matrix;
    };

    return step;
}

정의/선언 원문

MotionStep Motion::linear(const LinearMotion& config) {
    if (!detail::finiteVector(config.from) || !detail::finiteVector(config.to) ||
        !std::isfinite(config.durationSeconds) || config.durationSeconds <= 0 ||
        (config.playback != Playback::Once && config.playback != Playback::Loop &&
         config.playback != Playback::PingPong) ||
        (config.space != TransformSpace::World && config.space != TransformSpace::Local))
        return {};

    PathMotion path;

    path.path = [from = glm::dvec3(config.from), to = glm::dvec3(config.to)](double u) {
        return glm::vec3((1 - u) * from + u * to);
    };
    path.durationSeconds = config.durationSeconds;
    path.playback = config.playback;
    path.space = config.space;

    return followPath(path);
}

그래프의 직접 호출 후보이 앵커의 직접 호출 간선이 없음. 아래 본문과 pipeline의 콜백 흐름을 확인한다.

정의/선언 원문

MotionStep Motion::pendulum(const PendulumMotion& config) {
    MotionStep step;

    if (!std::isfinite(config.amplitudeDegrees) || config.amplitudeDegrees < 0 ||
        !std::isfinite(config.periodSeconds) || config.periodSeconds <= 0 || !std::isfinite(config.phaseDegrees) ||
        !std::isfinite(config.offsetDegrees) ||
        !std::isfinite(std::abs(config.offsetDegrees) + config.amplitudeDegrees) ||
        (config.space != TransformSpace::World && config.space != TransformSpace::Local) ||
        !TransformSystem::rotation(config.axis, config.offsetDegrees))
        return step;
    step.space = config.space;
    step.transform = [config](double seconds) {
        constexpr double pi = 3.14159265358979323846;
        const double phase = std::remainder(seconds, config.periodSeconds) / config.periodSeconds * 2 * pi +
                             std::remainder(config.phaseDegrees, 360.0) * pi / 180;
        const auto matrix =
            TransformSystem::rotation(config.axis, config.offsetDegrees + config.amplitudeDegrees * std::sin(phase));

        if (!matrix)
            throw std::domain_error("Pendulum motion produced an invalid matrix.");

        return *matrix;
    };

    return step;
}

std::optional<MotionId> MotionSystem::createMotion(const Motion& motion) {
    const auto sample = motion.sample(0);

    if (!sample || nextMotion_ == std::numeric_limits<MotionId>::max())
        return (
            Diagnostics::failAt(__FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::createMotion",
                                "Rejected condition: !sample || nextMotion_ == std::numeric_limits<MotionId>::max()",
                                "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."),
            std::nullopt);

    const auto id = nextMotion_;
    MotionState state;

    state.motion = motion;
    state.sampled = *sample;
    motions_.emplace(id, std::move(state));
    ++nextMotion_;

    return id;
}

bool MotionSystem::setMotion(MotionId id, const Motion& motion) {
    const auto found = motions_.find(id);

    if (found == motions_.end())
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::setMotion",
            "Rejected condition: found == motions_.end()",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    const auto sample = motion.sample(found->second.timeSeconds);

    if (!sample)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::setMotion", "Rejected condition: !sample",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);
    found->second.motion = motion;
    found->second.sampled = *sample;

    return true;
}

정의/선언 원문

bool MotionSystem::update(double deltaSeconds) {
    if (!std::isfinite(deltaSeconds) || deltaSeconds < 0)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::update",
            "Rejected condition: !std::isfinite(deltaSeconds) || deltaSeconds < 0",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.");

    struct Pending {
        MotionId id;
        double time;
        MotionSample sample;
        std::optional<Motion> actions;
    };

    std::vector<Pending> pending;

    pending.reserve(motions_.size());

    for (const auto& entry : motions_) {
        const auto& state = entry.second;

        if (!state.playing)
            continue;

        const double time = state.timeSeconds + deltaSeconds;
        const auto sample = state.motion.sample(time);

        if (!sample)
            return Diagnostics::failAt(
                __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::update", "Rejected condition: !sample",
                "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.");
        const auto& steps = state.motion.getSteps();
        const bool actions = state.enabled && std::any_of(steps.begin(), steps.end(),
                                                         [](const auto& step) { return bool(step.action); });
        pending.push_back({entry.first, time, *sample, actions ? std::optional<Motion>(state.motion) : std::nullopt});
    }

    for (const auto& item : pending) {
        auto& state = motions_.at(item.id);

        state.timeSeconds = item.time;
        state.sampled = item.sample;
    }
    for (const auto& item : pending)
        if (item.actions && !item.actions->execute(item.time))
            return false;

    return true;
}

std::optional<LayerId> MotionSystem::insertLayer(LayerId child, const LayerConfig& config) {
    const auto current = getLayer(child);

    if (!current || !current->parent || !validLayer(config) || nextLayer_ == std::numeric_limits<LayerId>::max())
        return (
            Diagnostics::failAt(
                __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::insertLayer",

            std::nullopt);

    const auto parent = *current->parent;
    const auto id = nextLayer_;
    auto staged = layers_;

    staged.emplace(id, LayerState{config, parent, {child}});

    auto& siblings = staged.at(parent).children;

    std::replace(siblings.begin(), siblings.end(), child, id);
    staged.at(child).parent = id;
    layers_.swap(staged);
    ++nextLayer_;

    return id;
}

정의/선언 원문

bool MotionSystem::removeLayer(LayerId id) {
    const auto current = getLayer(id);

    if (!current || !current->parent)
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::removeLayer",
            "Rejected condition: !current || !current->parent",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    auto staged = layers_;
    const auto parent = *current->parent;
    auto& siblings = staged.at(parent).children;
    const auto position = std::find(siblings.begin(), siblings.end(), id);
    const auto index = std::size_t(position - siblings.begin());

    siblings.erase(position);
    siblings.insert(siblings.begin() + index, current->children.begin(), current->children.end());

    for (auto child : current->children)
        staged.at(child).parent = parent;
    staged.erase(id);
    layers_.swap(staged);

    return true;
}

bool MotionSystem::reparentLayer(LayerId id, LayerId parent) {
    const auto current = getLayer(id);

    if (!current || !current->parent || !getLayer(parent))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::reparentLayer",
            "Rejected condition: !current || !current->parent || !getLayer(parent)",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);

    if (current->parent == parent)
        return true;

    auto ancestor = std::optional<LayerId>(parent);

    while (ancestor) {
        if (*ancestor == id)
            return Diagnostics::failAt(
                __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::reparentLayer",
                "Rejected condition: *ancestor == id",
                "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);
        ancestor = layers_.at(*ancestor).parent;
    }

    auto staged = layers_;
    auto& old = staged.at(*current->parent).children;

    old.erase(std::find(old.begin(), old.end(), id));
    staged.at(parent).children.push_back(id);
    staged.at(id).parent = parent;
    layers_.swap(staged);

    return true;
}

정의/선언 원문

bool MotionSystem::setLayer(LayerId id, const LayerConfig& config) {
    const auto found = layers_.find(id);

    if (found == layers_.end() || !validLayer(config))
        return Diagnostics::failAt(
            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::setLayer",
            "Rejected condition: found == layers_.end() || !validLayer(config)",
            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships.", id);
    found->second.config = config;

    return true;
}

bool MotionSystem::bindMotion(LayerId layer, std::optional<MotionId> motion) {

정의/선언 원문

std::optional<MotionSample> MotionSystem::layerMatrices(LayerId leaf) const {
    std::vector<LayerId> chain;
    auto current = std::optional<LayerId>(leaf);

    while (current) {
        const auto layer = getLayer(*current);

        if (!layer || chain.size() >= layers_.size())
            return (Diagnostics::failAt(
                        __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::layerMatrices",
                        "Rejected condition: !layer || chain.size() >= layers_.size()",
                        "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."),
                    std::nullopt);
        chain.push_back(*current);
        current = layer->parent;
    }

    MotionSample result;

    for (auto i = chain.rbegin(); i != chain.rend(); ++i) {
        const auto& config = layers_.at(*i).config;

        if (!config.enabled)
            continue;

        MotionSample own;

        if (config.space == TransformSpace::World)
            own.parent = config.transform;
        else
            own.local = config.transform;

        if (config.motion) {
            const auto state = getMotion(*config.motion);

            if (!state)
                return (Diagnostics::failAt(
                            __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::layerMatrices",
                            "Rejected condition: !state",
                            "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."),
                        std::nullopt);

            if (state->enabled) {
                own.parent = state->sampled.parent * own.parent;
                own.local = state->sampled.local * own.local;
            }
        }

        if (*i == rootLayer())
            result.parent = own.parent * own.local;
        else {
            result.parent *= own.parent;
            result.local *= own.local;
        }

        if (!TransformSystem::validAffine(result.parent) || !TransformSystem::validAffine(result.local))
            return (
                Diagnostics::failAt(
                    __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Motion, "MotionSystem::layerMatrices",
                    "Rejected condition: !TransformSystem::validAffine(result.parent) || !TransformSystem::validAffine(result.local)",
                    "Check finite values, valid IDs, dimensions, indices and parent/layer relationships."),
                std::nullopt);
    }

    return result;
}

std::optional<MotionId> MotionSystem::createMotion(std::initializer_list<MotionStep> steps) {
    Motion motion;
    for (const auto& step : steps)
        if (!motion.append(step)) return std::nullopt;
    return createMotion(motion);
}

정의/선언 원문

inline std::filesystem::path executableDirectory() {
    std::wstring path(32768, L'\0');
    const DWORD size = GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, path.data(), DWORD(path.size()));

    if (!size || size >= path.size())
        throw std::runtime_error("Cannot locate the executable directory.");
    path.resize(size);

    return std::filesystem::path(path).parent_path();

정의/선언 원문

inline std::filesystem::path relativePathInside(const std::filesystem::path& root,
                                                const std::filesystem::path& relative) {
    if (relative.empty() || relative.is_absolute() || relative.has_root_name() || relative.has_root_directory())
        throw std::runtime_error("Use a relative path inside the project.");

    const auto base = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(root);
    const auto full = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(base / relative);
    auto a = base.begin(), b = full.begin();

    for (; a != base.end(); ++a, ++b)
        if (b == full.end() || *a != *b)
            throw std::runtime_error("Path leaves the project directory.");

    return full;
}

정의/선언 원문

class Module {
    HMODULE handle_ = nullptr;

public:
    Module() = default;
    Module(const Module&) = delete;

    Module& operator=(const Module&) = delete;

    ~Module() {
        if (handle_)
            FreeLibrary(handle_);
    }

    void open(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
        if (handle_)
            return;
        handle_ =
            LoadLibraryExW(path.c_str(), nullptr, LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DLL_LOAD_DIR | LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DEFAULT_DIRS);

        if (!handle_) {
            const DWORD error = GetLastError();
            const auto message = "DLL=" + path.u8string() + "; Win32 error=" + std::to_string(error);

            Diagnostics::failAt(
                __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Module::open", message,
                "Keep the complete x64 framework/dependencies folder beside the executable; check DLL architecture and dependent runtimes.");
            throw std::runtime_error(message);
        }
    }

    template <class T> T symbol(const char* name) const {
        const auto address = ::GetProcAddress(handle_, name);

        if (!address) {
            Diagnostics::failAt(
                __FILE__, __LINE__, PipelineStage::Runtime, "Module::symbol",
                std::string("Missing runtime export: ") + name,
                "Use the bundled DLL version. For OpenGL functions, check that an OpenGL 3.3 context is current.");
            throw std::runtime_error(std::string("Missing runtime export: ") + name);
        }

        return reinterpret_cast<T>(address);
    }
}

struct GlfwApi {
    Module module;
    bool ready = false;

    decltype(&::glfwInit) Init = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwSetErrorCallback) SetErrorCallback = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwTerminate) Terminate = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwWindowHint) WindowHint = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwCreateWindow) createWindow = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwDestroyWindow) DestroyWindow = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwMakeContextCurrent) MakeContextCurrent = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwGetCurrentContext) GetCurrentContext = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwSwapInterval) SwapInterval = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwSetInputMode) SetInputMode = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwSetWindowUserPointer) SetWindowUserPointer = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwGetWindowUserPointer) GetWindowUserPointer = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwSetKeyCallback) SetKeyCallback = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwSetWindowFocusCallback) SetWindowFocusCallback = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwSetMouseButtonCallback) SetMouseButtonCallback = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwSetCursorPosCallback) SetCursorPosCallback = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwGetCursorPos) GetCursorPos = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwGetWindowSize) GetWindowSize = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwGetFramebufferSize) GetFramebufferSize = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwWindowShouldClose) WindowShouldClose = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwSetWindowShouldClose) SetWindowShouldClose = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwGetTime) GetTime = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwPollEvents) PollEvents = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwWaitEvents) WaitEvents = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glfwSwapBuffers) SwapBuffers = nullptr;

    void load(const std::filesystem::path& root = std::filesystem::path{}) {
        if (ready)
            return;
        module.open((root.empty() ? frameworkDirectory() : std::filesystem::absolute(root)) /
                    "dependencies/glfw-3.4.bin.WIN64/lib-vc2022/glfw3.dll");
        Init = module.symbol<decltype(Init)>("glfwInit");
        SetErrorCallback = module.symbol<decltype(SetErrorCallback)>("glfwSetErrorCallback");
        Terminate = module.symbol<decltype(Terminate)>("glfwTerminate");
        WindowHint = module.symbol<decltype(WindowHint)>("glfwWindowHint");
        createWindow = module.symbol<decltype(createWindow)>("glfwCreateWindow");
        DestroyWindow = module.symbol<decltype(DestroyWindow)>("glfwDestroyWindow");
        MakeContextCurrent = module.symbol<decltype(MakeContextCurrent)>("glfwMakeContextCurrent");
        GetCurrentContext = module.symbol<decltype(GetCurrentContext)>("glfwGetCurrentContext");
        SwapInterval = module.symbol<decltype(SwapInterval)>("glfwSwapInterval");
        SetInputMode = module.symbol<decltype(SetInputMode)>("glfwSetInputMode");
        SetWindowUserPointer = module.symbol<decltype(SetWindowUserPointer)>("glfwSetWindowUserPointer");
        GetWindowUserPointer = module.symbol<decltype(GetWindowUserPointer)>("glfwGetWindowUserPointer");
        SetKeyCallback = module.symbol<decltype(SetKeyCallback)>("glfwSetKeyCallback");
        SetWindowFocusCallback = module.symbol<decltype(SetWindowFocusCallback)>("glfwSetWindowFocusCallback");
        SetMouseButtonCallback = module.symbol<decltype(SetMouseButtonCallback)>("glfwSetMouseButtonCallback");
        SetCursorPosCallback = module.symbol<decltype(SetCursorPosCallback)>("glfwSetCursorPosCallback");
        GetCursorPos = module.symbol<decltype(GetCursorPos)>("glfwGetCursorPos");
        GetWindowSize = module.symbol<decltype(GetWindowSize)>("glfwGetWindowSize");
        GetFramebufferSize = module.symbol<decltype(GetFramebufferSize)>("glfwGetFramebufferSize");
        WindowShouldClose = module.symbol<decltype(WindowShouldClose)>("glfwWindowShouldClose");
        SetWindowShouldClose = module.symbol<decltype(SetWindowShouldClose)>("glfwSetWindowShouldClose");
        GetTime = module.symbol<decltype(GetTime)>("glfwGetTime");
        PollEvents = module.symbol<decltype(PollEvents)>("glfwPollEvents");
        WaitEvents = module.symbol<decltype(WaitEvents)>("glfwWaitEvents");
        SwapBuffers = module.symbol<decltype(SwapBuffers)>("glfwSwapBuffers");
        ready = true;
    }
}

정의/선언 원문

struct GlApi {
    Module module;

    using WglGetProc = PROC(WINAPI*)(LPCSTR);

    WglGetProc wglGetProc = nullptr;

    decltype(&::glClearColor) ClearColor = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glClear) Clear = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glEnable) Enable = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glDisable) Disable = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glDepthMask) DepthMask = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glColorMask) ColorMask = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glDepthFunc) DepthFunc = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glViewport) Viewport = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glScissor) Scissor = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glCullFace) CullFace = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glFrontFace) FrontFace = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glPolygonMode) PolygonMode = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glDrawElements) DrawElements = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glGenTextures) GenTextures = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glBindTexture) BindTexture = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glTexParameteri) TexParameteri = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glTexImage2D) TexImage2D = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glPixelStorei) PixelStorei = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glDeleteTextures) DeleteTextures = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glGetIntegerv) GetIntegerv = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glGetError) GetError = nullptr;
    decltype(&::glLineWidth) LineWidth = nullptr;

    PFNGLGENVERTEXARRAYSPROC GenVertexArrays = nullptr;
    PFNGLBINDVERTEXARRAYPROC BindVertexArray = nullptr;
    PFNGLDELETEVERTEXARRAYSPROC DeleteVertexArrays = nullptr;
    PFNGLGENBUFFERSPROC GenBuffers = nullptr;
    PFNGLBINDBUFFERPROC BindBuffer = nullptr;
    PFNGLBUFFERDATAPROC BufferData = nullptr;
    PFNGLDELETEBUFFERSPROC DeleteBuffers = nullptr;
    PFNGLVERTEXATTRIBPOINTERPROC VertexAttribPointer = nullptr;
    PFNGLVERTEXATTRIBIPOINTERPROC VertexAttribIPointer = nullptr;
    PFNGLENABLEVERTEXATTRIBARRAYPROC EnableVertexAttribArray = nullptr;
    PFNGLCREATESHADERPROC CreateShader = nullptr;
    PFNGLSHADERSOURCEPROC ShaderSource = nullptr;
    PFNGLCOMPILESHADERPROC CompileShader = nullptr;
    PFNGLGETSHADERIVPROC GetShaderiv = nullptr;
    PFNGLGETSHADERINFOLOGPROC GetShaderInfoLog = nullptr;
    PFNGLDELETESHADERPROC DeleteShader = nullptr;
    PFNGLCREATEPROGRAMPROC CreateProgram = nullptr;
    PFNGLATTACHSHADERPROC AttachShader = nullptr;
    PFNGLLINKPROGRAMPROC LinkProgram = nullptr;
    PFNGLGETPROGRAMIVPROC GetProgramiv = nullptr;
    PFNGLGETPROGRAMINFOLOGPROC GetProgramInfoLog = nullptr;
    PFNGLDETACHSHADERPROC DetachShader = nullptr;
    PFNGLDELETEPROGRAMPROC DeleteProgram = nullptr;
    PFNGLGETUNIFORMLOCATIONPROC GetUniformLocation = nullptr;
    PFNGLUSEPROGRAMPROC UseProgram = nullptr;
    PFNGLUNIFORMMATRIX4FVPROC UniformMatrix4fv = nullptr;
    PFNGLUNIFORMMATRIX3FVPROC UniformMatrix3fv = nullptr;
    PFNGLUNIFORM3FPROC Uniform3f = nullptr;
    PFNGLUNIFORM1IPROC Uniform1i = nullptr;
    PFNGLUNIFORM1FPROC Uniform1f = nullptr;
    PFNGLACTIVETEXTUREPROC ActiveTexture = nullptr;

    template <class T> T resolve(const char* name) {
        PROC p = wglGetProc(name);

        if (!p || p == reinterpret_cast<PROC>(1) || p == reinterpret_cast<PROC>(2) || p == reinterpret_cast<PROC>(3) ||
            p == reinterpret_cast<PROC>(-1))
            p = module.symbol<PROC>(name);

        return reinterpret_cast<T>(p);
    }

    void load() {
        std::wstring directory(32768, L'\0');
        const UINT size = GetSystemDirectoryW(directory.data(), UINT(directory.size()));

        if (!size || size >= directory.size())
            throw std::runtime_error("Cannot find Windows system directory.");
        directory.resize(size);
        module.open(std::filesystem::path(directory) / "opengl32.dll");
        wglGetProc = module.symbol<WglGetProc>("wglGetProcAddress");
        ClearColor = resolve<decltype(ClearColor)>("glClearColor");
        Clear = resolve<decltype(Clear)>("glClear");
        Enable = resolve<decltype(Enable)>("glEnable");
        Disable = resolve<decltype(Disable)>("glDisable");
        DepthMask = resolve<decltype(DepthMask)>("glDepthMask");
        ColorMask = resolve<decltype(ColorMask)>("glColorMask");
        DepthFunc = resolve<decltype(DepthFunc)>("glDepthFunc");
        Viewport = resolve<decltype(Viewport)>("glViewport");
        Scissor = resolve<decltype(Scissor)>("glScissor");
        CullFace = resolve<decltype(CullFace)>("glCullFace");
        FrontFace = resolve<decltype(FrontFace)>("glFrontFace");
        PolygonMode = resolve<decltype(PolygonMode)>("glPolygonMode");
        DrawElements = resolve<decltype(DrawElements)>("glDrawElements");
        GenTextures = resolve<decltype(GenTextures)>("glGenTextures");
        BindTexture = resolve<decltype(BindTexture)>("glBindTexture");
        TexParameteri = resolve<decltype(TexParameteri)>("glTexParameteri");
        TexImage2D = resolve<decltype(TexImage2D)>("glTexImage2D");
        PixelStorei = resolve<decltype(PixelStorei)>("glPixelStorei");
        DeleteTextures = resolve<decltype(DeleteTextures)>("glDeleteTextures");
        GetIntegerv = resolve<decltype(GetIntegerv)>("glGetIntegerv");
        GetError = resolve<decltype(GetError)>("glGetError");

    template <class T> T resolve(const char* name) {
        PROC p = wglGetProc(name);

        if (!p || p == reinterpret_cast<PROC>(1) || p == reinterpret_cast<PROC>(2) || p == reinterpret_cast<PROC>(3) ||
            p == reinterpret_cast<PROC>(-1))
            p = module.symbol<PROC>(name);

        return reinterpret_cast<T>(p);
    }

정의/선언 원문

inline bool checkGlAt(const char* file, int line, PipelineStage stage, const char* api) {
    bool success = true;

    for (GLenum code = gl().GetError(); code != GL_NO_ERROR; code = gl().GetError()) {
        const char* cause =
            code == GL_INVALID_ENUM                    ? "GL_INVALID_ENUM: unsupported enum"
            : code == GL_INVALID_VALUE                 ? "GL_INVALID_VALUE: value outside allowed range"
            : code == GL_INVALID_OPERATION             ? "GL_INVALID_OPERATION: incompatible binding, state or program"
            : code == GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY                 ? "GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY: GPU allocation failed"
            : code == GL_INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION ? "GL_INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION: incomplete framebuffer"
                                                       : "OpenGL error";

        Diagnostics::failAt(
            file, line, stage, api, std::string(cause) + " (" + std::to_string(code) + ")",
            "Inspect this stage's bindings, buffer sizes, vertex layout, shader log and current context. A GL error does not identify a single root cause.");
        success = false;
    }

    return success;
}
